summary: Frontend-only hot-fix verification for the react-hooks/rules-of-hooks compile error in EditClientDialog.jsx. Code review confirms all three useState calls (f, saving, dateOpen) are declared at lines 21-23, before the `if (!f) return null;` early return at line 47. Webpack now compiles with warnings only (no ERROR block) per /var/log/supervisor/frontend.out.log. Playwright E2E: /login renders with no webpack error overlay, login as demo@clientrevive.ai succeeded, dashboard + clients list (19 clients) render, client profile opens, btn-edit-client opens dialog with all fields prefilled (Tania Putri / 6281234567800 / Aktif / Sedang), Status->VIP and Prioritas->Tinggi selected, Follow-Up Berikutnya Popover opened, date selection closed the popover and updated the button label to 2026-08-10, btn-save-edit persisted changes (toast 'Klien diperbarui', VIP + Prioritas: Tinggi still present after full page reload), btn-cancel-edit and btn-close-edit both close the dialog without saving. No console errors captured.

issues: 'Menganalisis...' spinner state was still displayed several seconds after page load/reload; verify the AI analysis call resolves or add a timeout/error state so the card does not appear stuck

action_items: Optional cleanup: remaining react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings in src/components/app/ReminderBanner.jsx (line 35) and src/pages/ClientProfile.jsx (lines 69, 70) - warnings only, not blocking compile
critical_code_review_comments: EditClientDialog: hooks order is now correct. Consider replacing `if (!f) return null;` with rendering the Dialog only when open && f to avoid the dialog mount/unmount race, though current behavior tested fine.
seed_data_creation: None new; used existing demo account seed data. One client (Tania Putri) was updated to status VIP, priority Tinggi, next_follow_up_date 2026-08-10 as part of the edit test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hot-fix verified. Edit Klien dialog (data-testids: btn-edit-client, edit-name, edit-status, edit-priority, edit-nextdate, btn-save-edit, btn-cancel-edit, btn-close-edit) fully functional. Clients route is /klien. Only remaining lint issues are exhaustive-deps warnings. Backend tests were intentionally skipped this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was `const [dateOpen, setDateOpen] = useState(false)` declared after the `if (!f) return null;` early return, violating rules-of-hooks and failing the CRA eslint check as an ERROR (red overlay). Fix moved the hook to the top with the other useState calls; verified in source and via clean webpack compile.
